metadata.question: In April 2023, did southern Spain experience temperatures over 90 degrees Fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use ERA5 or Landsat thermal data for April 2023 in southern Spain - ERA5 is better for temperature data (surface temperature) - Southern Spain: approximately 36-37°N, 2-4°W (e.g., Andalusia region) - Filter for April 2023 (2023-04-01 to 2023-04-30) 2. Masking strategy: - ERA5 has no cloud masking needed; it's reanalysis data - Focus on mean/max temperature aggregation 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check if collection has data: `.size().getInfo()` > 0 - Calculate mean temperature and convert to Fahrenheit - 90°F = 32.2°C - Check if any pixel or mean exceeds this threshold - Valid result: temperature value is numeric and in reasonable range (-50 to 60°C for surface temp) - Invalid: NaN, None, or unrealistic values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define southern Spain region (Andalusia) const southernSpain = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-6, 36], [-1, 36], [-1, 38], [-6, 38], [-6, 36]] ]); // 2. Load ERA5 temperature data for April 2023 const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/ERA5/MONTHLY') .filter(ee.Filter.date('2023-04-01', '2023-05-01')) .select('mean_2m_air_temperature'); const collectionSize = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5 Images in April 2023: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No ERA5 data found for April 2023."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate mean temperature over southern Spain const meanTemp = era5.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernSpain, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo(); if (meanTemp === null || isNaN(meanTemp)) { console.log("Temperature calculation returned null or NaN."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Convert from Kelvin to Celsius and then to Fahrenheit const tempCelsius = meanTemp - 273.15; const tempFahrenheit = (tempCelsius * 9/5) + 32; // 5. Also get maximum temperature for context const maxTemp = era5.max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: southernSpain, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature').getInfo(); const maxTempFahrenheit = (maxTemp - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; // 6. Validation and answer console.log(`April 2023 Southern Spain - Mean Temp: ${tempFahrenheit.toFixed(1)}°F (${tempCelsius.toFixed(1)}°C)`); console.log(`April 2023 Southern Spain - Max Temp: ${maxTempFahrenheit.toFixed(1)}°F`); console.log(`Pixel Count: ${collectionSize}`); // Check if temperatures exceed 90°F (32.2°C) const threshold90F = 32.2; // Celsius equivalent if (tempFahrenheit > 90 || maxTempFahrenheit > 90) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
